datasets.name: Credits
datasets.sql:
select rownum,c.ID, c.ContNum,b.FIRSTNAME||' '||b.lastname||' '||b.MIDDLENAME as   CustName,c.accid,
       a.acc_no as accno,c.opendate,c.expdate  as closedate,av.val_name,c.contamount as creditamount,
       cm.ID companyid,bl.bld_name, c.flatid, bl.id as  BUILDINGID, f.flatnumber, c.branchid,f.code,
       c.userid, c.rest, cm.comp_name, f.entrance, f.ffloor, f.area,bl.address,c.monthpay,c.initialamount
from cc_contracts c, account a, cc_buyers b,  cc_companies cm, cc_buildings bl, cc_flats f, avalute av
where  c.accid = a.id and c.buyer = b.id and c.flatid = f.id and f.bld_id = bl.id and bl.comp_id = cm.id and av.valute = c.contcur 






order by :title

datasets.name: Hesabat
datasets.sql:
select  f.code Menzil_kod,  c.ContNum as Muqavile_nom  ,  cm.comp_name as Layihe, bl.bld_name as Bina,
f.entrance as Giris, f.ffloor as Mertebe, f.flatnumber as Menzil,   f.area as Sahe, f.price1 as kv_qiy, f.pricegen as Umumi_qiy,
 c.contamount as Muqvile_deyeri, c.opendate as Achilma_tar, c.expdate as Bitme_tar, c.closedate as Baglanma_tar,
  b.firstname as Soyadi, b.lastname as Adi, b.middlename as Ataadi , cc_general.cemiodenish(c.id,99)+ cc_general.cemiodenish(c.id,100) as tekrar_ve_ilk_odeme,
  cc_general.cemiodenish(c.id,92) as Sahe_odenis, cc_general.cemiodenish(c.id,93) as Tertibat, cc_general.cemiodenish(c.id,96) as Cerime
from cc_contracts c,  cc_buyers b,  cc_companies cm, cc_buildings bl, cc_flats f
where c.closedate is null and  c.buyer = b.id
 and c.flatid = f.id and f.bld_id = bl.id and bl.comp_id = cm.id

datasets.name: ReportPayOrderData
datasets.sql:
SELECT p.id, p.paydate, 
       p.payamt,a.CONTAMOUNT,
       CC_GENERAL.get_contractaccount(a.accid) as LoanAccno,  
       CC_GENERAL.get_contractaccount(a.buyer) as ClientAccno,
       b.firstname||' '||b.lastname||' '||middlename as name,
       a.opendate,
       a.contnum as ccontractno,
       av.val_name,a.DUEINTERESTRATE,
 TRUNC (MONTHS_BETWEEN (A.OPENDATE,A.EXPDATE)) as period
  FROM cc_payments p,
       cc_contracts a,
       cc_buyers b,
       avalute av
where a.id =p.id#
and   a.buyer = b.id
and   av.valute = a.contcur
and   p.id = :PayID
